scope: Independent bilingual semantic-equivalence and completeness review for the English translation. Existing accepted research and detailed-design conclusions, versions, architecture, obligations and evidence boundaries are preserved. This is a new review of the exact translated content for acceptance-binding migration, not a claim that historical reviewers reviewed the new hashes, not a fresh technical experiment, and not product implementation or release acceptance.
review_method: Read all 381 distinct source/target changed-line pairs, covering all 1652 changed-line occurrences across D01–D21 and A01–A24/B01–B24. Identical repeated template pairs were reviewed once and every occurrence was mapped and compared.

Independently reviewed every D01–D21 declared output: all 21 Design specifications, including 10 fully translated contracts and 11 specifications proven byte-identical to their accepted English source.

Read all 32 documentation-graph and 48 delivery-graph changed titles; recursively compared all JSON keys, array sizes, types and remaining scalar values. Only the four explicitly migrated per-node binding fields are excluded from graph semantic projection hashes.

Checked each D01–D21 original packet hash, original independent accepted review hash/decision and unchanged historical review bytes. Checked current packet hashes and all 162 embedded contract input rows in the 48 Delivery packets against the actual current specification bytes.

Checked IDs, versions, dependency lists and pins, outputs, write scopes, machine fields, numeric constraints and code/reference preservation. Delivery tasks remain planned_candidate and not_authorized, with no acceptance evidence or independent task-acceptance reviews added.

Reported EN-REV-R04 to the author and verified every one of the 115 corrected files contained exactly the reviewed shared-clause substitution. Reread the final integrated packet clause and the final C-TX-001 hash-only input-table delta before freezing this report.

findings.author_correction_scope: All 114 current task packets and tools/render_packets.py; exactly one shared-clause replacement per file.
findings.finding: database/ORM query relationships could be read as relationships between queries, rather than the source allocation of query and relationship responsibilities to Rust.
findings.resolution: The author changed the phrase to database/ORM queries and relationships. Every affected file was checked for exactly this change and no other bytes in the corrective commit; the final integrated clause was reread.

limitations: The 48 Delivery packet and graph decisions concern translation equivalence only. No Delivery task is marked implemented or accepted. Existing design acceptance does not establish product, performance or release completion.

Full current graph SHA hashes are deliberately not pinned because their review bindings refer to this report; semantic_projection_v1 pins every other graph field, while task packet and declared-output bytes are pinned in full and the generated acceptance bindings receive a separate attestation.
